bio: For fans of authentic Italian food, this ristorante makes for a pleasing alternative to JUWEL and WEBERSTUBE, the other two restaurants to be found here in the Hotel BEI SCHUMANN. Soak up the atmosphere in the wonderfully cosy dining area, in which Italian background music brings that feel-good factor, while the team in the open kitchen conjure up delicious fish and meat dishes, as well as classics such as antipasti, pasta and pizza cooked in the brick oven – the pizzas are available in smaller sizes, too. Desserts such as the zabaione di Marsala are also delicious. Speciality in winter: spaghetti from the parmesan cheese wheel. In summer, head for the pleasant terrace overlooking the SEEWUNDERBAR....
